title: BERT — Overview
text:
BERT — Overview
Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers
• Pretrained model that learns contextual text representations
(originally English; later multilingual / many languages)
• Use as a backbone: freeze or fine-tune, attach a task head
Downstream uses (examples):
• Text / sentiment classification
• Token tagging (NER1, POS2)
• Span extraction / question answering
• Sentence similarity, NLI3, retrieval
1NER: Named Entity Recognition — persons, orgs, locations, . . .
2POS: Part-of-Speech — noun, verb, adjective, . . .
3NLI: Natural Language Inference — entailment / contradiction / neutral.

title: GPT — Overview
text:
GPT — Overview
Generative Pre-trained Transformer
• Pretrained language model: learn to predict the next token (originally
English web text; now many languages / multimodal variants)
• Use as a generator: prompt in, continue / chat / follow instructions
Downstream uses (examples):
• Free-form text generation and chat
• Instruction following / assistants
• In-context / few-shot prompting
• Code generation, summarization via prompting

GPT: decoder-only
Decoder-only, causal
xt ∼p(xt | x<t)
• Here “decoder-only” = causal Transformer stack (no encoder
cross-attention)
• Train: next-token prediction (parallel over positions under causal mask)
• Infer: autoregressive decode (one token at a time)
Training is parallel across positions; generation is sequential across tokens.

title: T5 — Overview
text:
T5 — Overview
Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer
• Unified text-to-text pretrained model: every NLP task is “input text →
output text”
• Use as a conditional generator: encode the source, decode the target
Downstream uses (examples):
• Translation and summarization
• Question answering (answer as text)
• Classification cast as text (e.g. label words)
• Structured generation (parse, rewrite, fill slots)

title: ViT — Overview
text:
ViT — Overview
Vision Transformer
• Pretrained model that learns visual representations from image patches
(BERT-like encoder on vision)
• Use as a backbone: attach a head for recognition / detection / dense
prediction variants
Downstream uses (examples):
• Image classification
• Feature backbone for detection / segmentation
• Retrieval / similarity of images
• Vision–language models that reuse ViT encoders

(BERT-like encoder on vision)
• Use as a backbone: attach a head for recognition / detection / dense
prediction variants
Downstream uses (examples):
• Image classification
• Feature backbone for detection / segmentation
• Retrieval / similarity of images
• Vision–language models that reuse ViT encoders

title: ViT pipeline
text:
ViT pipeline
1 Split image into patches; project each to a patch-token embedding
2 Add positional embeddings (+ optional [CLS])
3 Transformer encoder (BERT-like)
4 Aggregation →classifier
SSL link
Masked patches (MAE-style) can define an SSL objective over visual tokens.
